name: Glutton Shackle
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Glutton Shackles lend strength to Arugal’s flawed sorcery. The mad archmage crafted these enchanted restraints for Moonrage Glutton worgen.

sections.title: A Crutch for Weak Sorcery
sections.body: Feral worgen infest Silverpine Forest, and the Forsaken’s trained mages see them as proof of poor arcane work. Dalar Dawnweaver, an accomplished arcanist stationed at the Sepulcher, holds Archmage Arugal in contempt and calls him an incompetent hack unworthy of the Kirin Tor. Dawnweaver found that Arugal relied on enchanted relics to shore up his fragile spells. The heavy Moonrage Gluttons that roam northern Silverpine wear Glutton Shackles, magical anchors that reinforce the curse binding the beasts.

sections.title: Fuel for Forsaken Countermeasures
sections.body: Arugal bound raw enchantments directly into heavy iron bands, leaving magical energy in the shackles even after their wearers are slain. Dawnweaver wants Forsaken agents to bring him the bands so he can study their construction and siphon their reserves. By examining the crude enchantments in the metal, the Forsaken hope to unravel the mysteries of the worgen curse and orchestrate the downfall of the beastmaster entrenched in Shadowfang Keep.

faq.answer: A Glutton Shackle is an enchanted iron restraint worn by Moonrage Glutton worgen in Silverpine Forest. Archmage Arugal crafted these bands to reinforce their wearers with magic and shore up his flawed spells.

faq.q: Why does Dalar Dawnweaver want Glutton Shackles?
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver wants the shackles to study Arugal’s crude enchantments and siphon their lingering magical energy. Understanding the items Arugal used to stabilize his beasts can help the Forsaken counter his magic.

Archmage Arugal enchanted the shackles. He was a former wizard of Dalaran who summoned the worgen to fight the Scourge and eventually lost his mind, binding his creations to his will with magical trinkets.

faq.q: Where are the creatures wearing these shackles found?
faq.answer: Moonrage Gluttons roam the woods and abandoned farmsteads of central and northern Silverpine Forest, often in packs alongside other corrupted Moonrage worgen.

angles.text: As a mage, you may recognize Dalar Dawnweaver’s biting critique of Arugal’s shoddy technique. Using physical enchanted crutches to stabilize simple transmutation and summoning spells marks a wizard as mediocre.
As a Forsaken, you know that gathering these shackles is essential to neutralizing the worgen threat pressing directly on the borders of the Sepulcher.
